reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis targets the wrong alloy system (NbMoTaVW instead of NbMoTaW) and relies on a VEC-based ductility criterion that is not generally reliable for refractory HEAs, with no mechanistic link to irradiation resistance.
reasons.testability: The proposed test compares the wrong baseline and does not include any high-temperature or irradiation assessment, so it cannot falsify the stated hypothesis about preserving those properties.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is off-topic because it addresses a different alloy system and fails to engage with the core challenge of balancing ductility, high-temperature strength, and irradiation resistance in NbMoTaW.
